description: KIDS FUN golden query set (G-T36-2). Each query runs over the REAL search path (evals/harness.ts) with expected top-results asserted. The flagship 'open gym near East Van' reuses the query semantics + thresholds defined once in lib/analytics/benchmark.ts (FLAGSHIP_QUERY): text mentions a gym AND carries an East-Van signal; must never be zero-result (maxZeroResultPct 0) and averages >= 5 results (minResults 5). Expectations are pinned to the current shipped FIXTURE_LISTINGS; see evals/scenarios/golden-db.test.ts + the findings doc for how the SAME set performs over the (currently thin) live ingested catalogue.
